sentences.text: The applicants have been arrested on 14.11.2019 in connection with the aforesaid crime.
It is doubtful as to whether Section 328 of the Indian Penal Code could be invoked.
Rest of the offences are bailable.
It will take time for completion of the investigation and resultant trial.
Pre-trial detention of the applicants is not warranted.
I am, therefore, inclined to grant bail to the applicants.

Hence, the following Order;
O R D E R (i) Application is allowed.

(ii) The applicants namely Rasul Rukmoddin Inamdar and Hanmant s/o Kupendra Gurav be released on bail in connection with Crime No. 389/2019 registered with MIDC Police Station, Dist.
Latur, for the offence punishable under Sections 272, 273, 328, 188 of the Indian Penal Code and under Sections 26(2)(i)(ii)(iii)(iv), 30(2)(a) read with Rule 3, 1, 7 and 2, 3, and 4 of the Food Safety and 3 BA 1446-19 Standard Act, 2006, on their executing P.R. Bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/-(Rupees Fifteen Thousand Only) each and surety bond each in the like amount.
